**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

- The Agreement contains no MFN burdening us. I checked the Compensation section (§ 5–6), the Client covenants (§ 8), and ran targeted searches ("most favored", "no less favorable", "favorable", "any other party", "rates", "exclusive") — nothing requires Mortgage Logic.com to give TrueLink terms no less favourable than those offered to third parties or to match third-party offers.
- The only parity language runs **in our favour**: § 6 (p0047) freezes Hosting Services costs for one year and caps our rates at no more than TrueLink charges any other party. Per the detection guidance, a Vendor-granted MFN is marked compliant and preserved.
- This sits at the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer), so no edit is warranted.
